```{julia}
events = select(elog, :time, :bee1_id, :bee2_id, :task_id)
filter!(row -> row.task_id != 0, events)
events.kind = ifelse.(events.bee1_id .== events.bee2_id, "train", "suppress")
# the "affected agent" for the event (for training it's the trainee; for suppression it's who gets suppressed)
events.agent = events.bee1_id
```

